origin.headline: One simple idea.
origin.p1: Bralto started from a pattern I kept seeing in every business I worked with: great products, great teams, healthy margins — but operations that completely depended on people for every single step. A sale lost because nobody picked up in time. A lead gone cold because follow-up came too late. A customer who left for the competitor because the competitor actually answered at 2am.
origin.p2: The problem wasn't a lack of tools. It was the exact opposite: duct-taped tech stacks with 8, 10, 15 different tools that don't talk to each other. CRMs over here, forms over there, half-built automations, broken integrations. Expensive software that ends up costing more in complexity than in licenses.
origin.p3: Bralto was built to fix that at the root. One platform that replaces the entire stack, paired with custom implementations that connect AI, data, and processes into a single system. We don't sell software. We rebuild how the business runs.
origin.statLabel: Years designing automated acquisition and operations systems
